name: John Deere Des Moines Works - Ankeny IA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Very large campus fully enclosed by a chain-link perimeter fence (confirmed on the west side in 2024 Street View) with a landscaped berm. Access is through controlled gates on the internal perimeter ring road off SW State St and other public roads; gate hardware itself is not reachable by Street View. A controlled truck gate is inferred from the fenced campus layout.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Set true: a fully fenced assembly campus of this scale (one of Deere's largest plants) is operated with staffed entry points; specific booth structures were not resolved in satellite imagery (medium confidence).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: ~12 distinct building masses across the campus: multiple assembly halls, large warehouses, and finished-goods buildings.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Multiple trailer drop areas plus enormous finished-goods marshaling yards holding rows of green John Deere equipment (sprayers, tillage tools, cotton harvesters) staged for shipment.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~45 truck dock positions estimated across multiple building faces; trailers seen backed in along north and west faces. Exact count not resolvable from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock clusters on different building faces (north-face trailer banks vs west/central docks) indicate separated shipping and receiving.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~620 acres for the fenced campus footprint; surrounding land includes Deere-owned development parcels.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban — campus sits inside the Des Moines metro fabric, ringed by Ankeny residential subdivisions and commercial development.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Vast paved aprons and wide internal ring roads leave abundant room for added or express truck lanes.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Estimated 3 controlled gates on the perimeter ring road; not all individually confirmed.
